a: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
p: Idhā zulzilati-l-arḍu zilzālahā, wa akhrajati-l-arḍu athqālahā… yawma'idhin tuḥaddithu akhbārahā.
m: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake And the earth discharges its burdens And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" - That Day, it will report its news Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
